hook: The drive to a paver seal job costs $203.44
hook_say: The drive to this paver job costs you $203.44.

rows.label: The paver job
rows.say: A paver clean, re-sand and seal
rows.why: The paver clean, re-sand and seal preset from the Trade Presets list. Its note says two visits: wash, then seal once dry.

rows.label: Crew and time on site
rows.why: Two people, six hours on site each, from the preset.

rows.label: Round-trip miles
rows.why: 40 round-trip miles for this job, from the preset. At 30 mph that is 1.33 hours of driving for each person.

rows.label: Sealer, sand and supplies
rows.why: Supplies for this job, from the preset.

rows.label: Drive time for 2 people + van
rows.why: Drive time for two people at the break-even rate, $173.04, plus the van at 76 cents a mile, $30.40.

rows.label: Price floor, zero profit
rows.why: Labor $778.69 plus the drive $203.44 plus supplies $180. Below this, the job loses money.

fix.label: Price with a 15% margin
fix.why: With a 15% margin (profit as a share of the price), rounded up to the next $5, the quote is $1,370: $207.87 of profit and a $342.50 deposit.
